input.value: fire caused by grease flare-up on stove; extinguished with fire extinguisher
charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls

input.rationale: Fire damage to the claimant's own kitchen cabinets, ceiling, and walls caused by an accidental grease flare-up on the claimant's own stove; this is direct damage to the claimant's property covered under property_damage.

Fire damage with charring to cabinets and smoke damage across multiple surfaces (ceiling, walls) suggests moderate damage requiring restoration work and potentially cabinet replacement, though no injuries and fire was contained to kitchen area.

input.claim_summary: Claim for POL-1001 (Alex Doe, active homeowners policy, $500 deductible, $250,000 coverage limit). Kitchen fire on yesterday evening caused by grease flare-up while cooking; claimant extinguished fire with fire extinguisher. Damage includes charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. No damage to rest of house. Classified as property_damage with high confidence (0.95) and medium severity due to multiple affected surfaces and restoration needs, though fire was contained and no injuries occurred.
